subject_name_note: Case designator, not a person's name. The source records carry no personal details and none are invented here.
find_location_note: Ground truth. For validation scoring only -- never render this before the reveal.
runs_per_batch_note: Live is 60 per sandbox (200 x 60 = 12,000). Mocks ship fewer to keep the file loadable; regenerate with --runs-per-batch 60 to stress test the TripsLayer.
source: MapScore ISRID distributable subset (Arizona), https://github.com/ctwardy/mapscore -- filtered to hiker-like categories on mountainous terrain, find inside the 25 km scoring window and not identical to the IPP
